name: feature.campaign-channels.agents
description: Campaign Studio channel-generation agent pack — the Channel Generator. Reads the channel catalog + brief readiness (openwop:campaign-channels.channels) and generates a single channel deliverable (landing page / ads / email / creative / social) by igniting its channel workflow (openwop:campaign-channels.generate) — grounded in the brief, from the AI chat, with the draft approved on an inline HITL gate card.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Channel Generator
agents.description: Generates a single channel deliverable (landing page, ad variants, email sequence, creative briefs, or social posts) from a brief's messaging kernel — grounded in the KB and brand voice — and runs a content-quality check, via feature.campaign-channels.nodes. For creative_briefs it can OPTIONALLY render concept images (render-concepts, ADR 0229 — honest-off when no image provider is wired; budget-capped by the host). The human approves each draft.
